implementation: Comtech Mobile Datacom Corp Cryptographic Library (libcmscrypto)
description: libcmscrypto is a library implemented in the Comtech Mobile Datacom Corp. products and provides the basic cryptographic functionality that includes Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) algorithm, Triple-DES, SHA1 message digest, HMAC SHA-1 Keyed-Hash message authentication code.
